Check an item's inventory

Find out how much of one item is in stock, where, and how much is already committed.

Procedure

1Find the item

Result
You know the item's on hand, blocked, on order and allocated.
Screen
Warehousing➔Inventory 360 (whwmd4300m000)

Why LN works this way. Inventory 360 is the starting point for any question about an item's stock. It shows four totals across every warehouse, and its header links open every other view of the same stock with the item already filled in.

StepActionYou should see
1.1Type the item in the filter box above the grid's Item column and press EnterThe item's row, and a row for any item whose code starts with it, showing On Hand · Blocked · On Order · Allocated
1.2Read the four quantities on the item's own rowWrite downon handblockedon orderallocated
1.3Tick the item rowThe header links become available, each with a green or grey dot. Item Order Plan stays greyed out
Find the item: if something goes wrong
SymptomWhat to do
No row appears for the itemThe item may have no inventory records yet, so there's nothing to report
The header links stay unavailableNo row is ticked. Tick the item's row
Item Order Plan is greyed out in the headerThat's expected. Open it through Planning instead: Item Order Plan (cprrp0520m000), Planning➔Order Planning➔Item Order Plan

2Read the stock by warehouse

Result
You've chosen the warehouse to work from and written down its figures.
Screen
Warehousing➔Inventory 360 (whwmd4300m000)

Why LN works this way. Stock is often spread over several warehouses, and a warehouse's name doesn't tell you what it holds. This view shows one row for each warehouse the item is known in, with or without stock, so you can choose the warehouse by its figures. Economic Stock on each row is on hand plus on order minus allocated. It goes negative when more is committed than the warehouse has or expects.

StepActionYou should see
2.1In the Inventory group of the header, click Warehouse InventoryWarehouse - Item Inventory (whwmd2515m000) opens with the item already filled in
2.2Read each row's Inventory on Hand and Inventory on OrderOne row per warehouse the item is known in, including ones that hold nothing
2.3Read each row's Inventory Allocated and Inventory Blocked
2.4Choose the warehouse to work from by its figures, not its nameWrite downwarehouseon handallocatedblocked
2.5Read the totals beneath the gridWrite downtotal on handtotal allocated
Read the stock by warehouse: if something goes wrong
SymptomWhat to do
On hand looks high enough, but an order won't fillCheck Inventory Allocated: other orders may already have claimed most of the on-hand
Economic Stock is negativeMore is committed than the warehouse holds and expects
